articles.title: PM Modi arrives in Australia, says visit will add vigour to Comprehensive Strategic Partnership
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi arrived in Australia for the second leg of his three-nation visit and will hold talks with Australian PM Albanese and interact with the Indian diaspora.

articles.title: "Visit has opened new avenues for cooperation": PM Modi concludes 3-day Indonesia visit
articles.summary: PM Modi concluded his Indonesia state visit, stating it opened new avenues for cooperation in defence, maritime collaboration, artificial intelligence and digital innovation.

articles.title: "PM Modi is stronger than any Prime Minister, can pursue major reforms": Surjit Bhalla
articles.summary: Economist Surjit Bhalla asserted that PM Modi possesses the political capital to initiate significant structural reforms in India, particularly regarding reservation framework and welfare schemes.

articles.title: PM Modi visits Indonesia's ancient Prambanan Temple with President Prabowo, offers prayers
articles.summary: PM Modi visited the historic Prambanan Temple complex with Indonesian President Prabowo and inaugurated India-backed conservation and restoration work at the UNESCO World Heritage site.

articles.title: "Steel equivalent to 40 new Eiffel towers or five Burj Khalifas, cabling could wrap the Earth twice": PM Modi refers to materials used in Rajasthan refinery complex
articles.summary: PM Modi highlighted India's rapid industrial progress, noting the massive scale of materials used in the Rajasthan refinery complex inaugurated on July 4, positioning India among top four nations in refining capacity.
